title: Weak association is preserved and reflected by etale algebra maps
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $L$ be any $A$-module, let $\mathfrak b\subset B$ be a prime ideal, and let $\mathfrak a$ be its inverse image in $A$. For a ring $T$ and a $T$-module $P$, define $\operatorname{WeakAss}_T(P)$ to consist of primes minimal among those containing $\operatorname{Ann}_T(x)=\{t\in T:tx=0\}$ for some $x\in P$. Give $L\otimes_A B$ the $B$-action on the second factor [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then $\mathfrak b\in\operatorname{WeakAss}_B(L\otimes_A B)$ if and only if $\mathfrak a\in\operatorname{WeakAss}_A(L)$. No Noetherian or finite-generation assumption is imposed.
